item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Front Door mutual TLS authentication
item.description:
Azure Front Door Premium now supports mutual TLS (mTLS) in general availability. It uses X.509 client certificates for client authentication to help protect sensitive applications and APIs.

  • Source: Azure Updates
